firm_data.firm_description: Ussery Law Group Inc. represents clients on and between both coasts from their offices in Los Angeles and Dallas. They have experience in sports, legacy/digital media, real estate, gaming and intellectual property.
notable_facts: The firm has entered into a co-counsel agreement with Levin, Papantonio, Rafferty to work together in the area of Mass Torts.
The firm represents Esports gamers who are becoming the new global athletes of the digital age.
The firm consults with participants in all aspects of the digital universe from engineers, inventors, gaming startups and gamers.
technology_signals: Represents clients in gaming, e-sports & technology
